c0-frame.title: Frame cycle 1 as shotgun
c0-frame.imperative: Flavor shotgun (human-picked). Run the five starting questions to lock the point, then diverge wide on framings/mechanisms for 'directed relevance'. Culls happen at consolidation, not now.

q1-point.title: Lock the point via the five starting questions
q1-point.imperative: Surface the point before solutions. Q1 itch, Q2 for-whom, Q3 done-feels-like, Q4 what-exists, Q5 kill-condition. Pre-answer Q1/Q4 from evidence; ask the human Q1-confirm/Q3/Q5.
q1-point.finding: PRE-ANSWERED (agent, from the two dumps + repo): Q1 itch = agents step on themselves pulling excess/adjacent detail; good thinking is directed (focus + deliberate expansion) over a network connected enough to inspire without chasing every vector. Q4 what-exists = episodes/ store (mechanical capture, docs/EPISODE_STORE.md), the rhyme sensor (#308, judgment layer), the lessons inbox->graduation loop (docs/RECURSIVE_IMPROVEMENT_DESIGN.md, ACE/Voyager cited), installed_externals_manifest.json (external corpora already tracked). PENDING HUMAN: Q1-confirm (is the point 'directed relevance' or 'the graph itself'?), Q3 done-feels-like, Q5 kill-condition.

q2-diverge.title: Shotgun divergence — ~24 one-liners for directed relevance
q2-diverge.imperative: Cheap wild one-liners in service of the point. NOT culled here (cull at consolidation). Clustered loosely for reading only.
q2-diverge.result: 24 entries generated; several elevated into the working model, two retired (see board Rejected).
q2-diverge.finding: See IDEAS_BOARD.md 'Shotgun divergence (cycle 1, un-culled)' section — 24 entries across: reframes of relevance, traversal mechanics, two-speed/working-graph, MCP boundary, federation, and wild/kill-the-graph.

consolidation: Cycle 1 started shotgun and converged toward refine as the human collapsed successive false forks into one control. SETTLED: (1) the graph is a given — exploration maps the pathways it enables, no concept-level kill condition; (2) the point is directed relevance (kill excess-detail overhead), directed traversal is a feature the graph enables; (3) the LIBRARIAN model — interface is question+context, mode selection is system-owned, response is a focused core + optional labeled doors; (4) THE DIAL is the single unifying control — it subsumes interpret-vs-answer, focus-vs-inspiration, and accumulate-vs-best-path, all shown to be one axis; dial rule: direct trace → silent core, unclear/strong-pull → open doors, default silence, expansion triggered; (5) two relevance filters — write-time sparsity already exists as the Cartographer map's Inclusion Rule, the read-time dial is the half we design; (6) SUBSTRATE = the existing architecture map (map-model.md), north star = generalize it from a code-view into a general knowledge graph, with the constraint that traversal not bake in architecture-only assumptions; (7) PULL = spreading activation, path-accumulated product of (edge-type-prior × confidence) with a status penalty — no hop-count term (retired: hop count ≠ conceptual reach). PHASING: near-term build = reliable traversal, static pull, dial pinned to its DIRECT setting (single best path). Deferred as later settings/weight-swaps, not rewrites: wider dial (cross-path accumulation, inspiration), learned pull (→ compounding memory), generalization beyond architecture. STILL OPEN (candidates for a next cycle): entry (question+context → start nodes — the crux, unsolved), dial-setting (how the system reads context to place the dial), the two-speed working/long-term graph (barely touched), and the generalization mechanism. NOT converged to spec — that is the human's call.
